meta.purpose: Speaking-only opening configurations for the three existing A1 café item versions.
meta.model_compatibility: Root _id values use MongoDB Extended JSON ObjectId. References are 24-hex BSON strings matching the Java String fields; import with MONGO_IMPORT_OBJECT_ID_FIELDS=none.

goals.title: Order an iced coffee
goals.description: Ask the barista for an iced coffee.

goals.title: Choose the small size
goals.description: Specify that you want a small drink.

goals.title: Answer the milk question
goals.description: Tell the barista whether you want milk.

speaking_item_configs.context: The learner is a customer at a café ordering a small iced coffee and answering whether they want milk. The AI is the barista taking the order.

goals.title: Explain the mistake
goals.description: Say that your drink is hot but should be iced.

goals.title: Request the correct drink
goals.description: Politely ask the barista to change the drink.

speaking_item_configs.context: The learner is a customer who received a hot coffee instead of the iced coffee they ordered. The AI is the barista helping correct the order.

goals.title: Ask for the price
goals.description: Ask the barista how much the drink costs.

goals.title: Pay by card
goals.description: Tell the barista that you want to pay by card.

goals.title: Say goodbye
goals.description: Thank the barista and say goodbye.

speaking_item_configs.context: The learner is a customer whose drink is ready. The learner asks its price, pays by card, and thanks the barista. The AI is the barista at the counter.
